turns.text: the dumpster behind lucky noodle got a firmware update. that's the whole post. that's my life now.

i jump up like i have every night for two years and the lid goes BEEP. the LID. it wants a loyalty scan to open. NEKOCORP put a paywall on GARBAGE. HOLY CAT PISS we are speedrunning the worst timeline and nobody's even going for the world record.

TIER THREE AND UP. for the DUMPSTER. i scanned out of pure spite and the little screen said TIER: NONE and played a sad chime. it has a sad chime for me specifically. some corpo cuck in a tower got a bonus for that chime and i hope his ergonomic chair fails him at a critical moment.

KNIFEBOY offered to shank the hinge. BRIK offered to bite it, which isn't a plan, that's just what BRIK does to objects. i told them both to hold their damn horses because i needed a minute to be theatrical about it first. this is called leadership.

and here's the shit nobody wants to hear: garbage is the city's real ledger. every empire writes its true books in what it throws away, and the day the strays learn to read the lid code is the day the towers start checking their locks. the trash remembers. the trash ALWAYS remembers. anyway.
so we bit the hinge. ok fine BRIK bit the hinge. the plan converged with the not-plan, whatever, history is written by whoever's holding the noodle box.

and inside? half a box of tier-three noodles. corpo garbage. PREMIUM garbage. and i gotta be honest with you: it was mid as hell. it tasted like escrow. rich cats are eating BAD and paying for the privilege and honestly that might be the most based thing about this economy.
tomorrow the lid gets a patch. the day after, we get a new tooth. this is the whole war in one alley and we are NOT losing it to a fucking chime.
